name: groomer
summary: Plain-rule tidy-up of a new to-do item: writes a finish line when none is given, suggests kind and grade, finds repeats among open machine-made items. No model call; kill switch and shadow mode.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (mode files live in $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.GROOM_STATE_DIR: optional: use this folder for the mode files and the counts log
env.MACHINE_SOURCES: optional: comma list of sources that are machines, default alarm,worker-followup,gate-note
env.PROTECTED_SOURCES: optional: comma list of sources that are people, never folded, default operator-chat,operator-tap,inbound-mail
